items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: "Little black Lucille was an aunt of mine"

ctx.x: Yeah. He spent some good years with Ray Charles.

Ray Charles. And there’s a difference between when he’s playing his down home thing that’s not the blues and if you listen to my latest CD you’ll find a piece called “Little Black Lucille.” “Little black Lucille was an aunt of mine who definitely wouldn’t want to be on a blues record. And she never heard this tune being played with a rhythm section and everything. I used to play it for her on the whistle and she liked it very much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
Well you spent some time at sea, correct?
